task_records.description: [P] [US3] Write report contract tests in `tests/test_metrics_report.py` before implementation; cover single-snapshot behavior; UTF-8 JSON objects no larger than 65,536 bytes; required fields `schema_version`, `invocation_id`, `run_id`, `step_id`, `invocation_kind`, `agent_name`, `skill_id`, `workflow_id`, `project_label`, `started_at`, `finished_at`, and `duration_ms` at exact types; `schema_version` exactly `1`, `invocation_kind` exactly `execution`, `continuation`, `retry`, or `probe`, exact millisecond timestamp grammar `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ`, signed duration equality, rejection of booleans/fractions, duplicate keys, nonfinite values, impossible timestamps, missing/empty required strings and unsupported schema/kind; `model` and `effort` absent or null normalize to null, non-null values must be nonempty strings, and other present types are invalid; rejection of strings over 32,767 characters or with illegal XML text without trimming/truncation; deduplication/conflicts; exact 13-column Excel order and shortened field mapping with JSON `schema_version` retained only for validation; literal text, numeric durations, zero-row output, no-clobber naming, output failures, failure above 1,000,000 accepted rows, unchanged input bytes, and missing dependency/source-layout failures before output creation without mutating the skill-tools environment (depends on T001).
